description: Start the engine of a Cessna 172 Skyhawk from cold and dark while lined up on the runway, configure it for takeoff (flaps 10, landing light), release the parking brake, apply full power, rotate at 55 knots and establish a climb at about 75 knots. Seen as the simulator's cockpit view: windshield on top, instrument panel below.

steps.completion_cue: Both red MASTER rockers are up with green 'ON' pills above them.

steps.instruction_es: Gira el selector de combustible a BOTH.
steps.completion_cue: The FUEL SELECTOR's upper half is lit green 'BOTH' and the pointer points up.

steps.instruction_es: Empuja la mezcla a fondo, a rica.
steps.completion_cue: The MIXTURE knob is flush with the panel and the placard above it is green 'RICH'.

steps.instruction_es: Gira la llave a START para arrancar el motor.
steps.completion_cue: The propeller is a gray blurred disc, the tachometer needle is near 9 and the key is on 'BOTH' (green pill).
The FLAPS readout shows a green '10°' and the lever is at the 10° mark.
The LAND rocker is up with a green 'ON' pill above it.
The PARK BRAKE handle is flush, no red 'SET' flag, the PARK BRAKE annunciator is dark.

steps.instruction_es: Ahora potencia máxima: empuja el acelerador a fondo.
steps.completion_cue: The THROTTLE placard is green 'FULL', the tachometer needle is near 23 and the runway rushes toward the plane.

steps.instruction_es: Al llegar a 55 nudos, tira suavemente del comando para rotar.
steps.completion_cue: The horizon is low in the windshield, mostly sky in view, and the runway drops away below the cowling.

steps.instruction_es: Mantén la nariz unos 7 grados arriba y sube a 75 nudos.
steps.completion_cue: Only sky and the distant horizon in the windshield, no runway close below; vertical speed needle up and right; altimeter turning.

mistakes.description: The key is turned to START before the master switch is on, the fuel selector is on BOTH and the mixture is rich: the engine won't start.
mistakes.visual_cue: The key is at START (amber 'START' pill and STARTER annunciator lit) while the FUEL SELECTOR shows red 'OFF', the MIXTURE placard shows red 'CUTOFF' or the MASTER pills are dark 'OFF'; the propeller turns slowly but never blurs into a disc.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, así no arranca. Antes de girar la llave: maestro encendido, combustible en BOTH y mezcla rica.

mistakes.description: Flaps are set to 30 degrees for takeoff instead of 10.
mistakes.visual_cue: The FLAPS readout shows a red '30°' and the flap lever is at the bottom mark.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, 30 grados de flaps es demasiado para despegar. Súbelos a 10.

mistakes.description: Full power is applied while the parking brake is still set: the plane doesn't move.
mistakes.visual_cue: The THROTTLE placard is green 'FULL' and the tachometer is high, but the red 'SET' flag under the PARK BRAKE handle and the red PARK BRAKE annunciator are still lit, and the runway in the windshield doesn't move.
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, tienes el freno de estacionamiento puesto. Reduce la potencia y suelta el freno antes de acelerar.

mistakes.description: The pilot pulls the yoke before reaching 55 knots, risking a stall on takeoff.
mistakes.visual_cue: The nose is up and the red STALL annunciator at the right end of the top row is lit.
mistakes.correction_es: ¡Ojo, muy temprano! Baja la nariz y espera los 55 nudos para rotar.
